selection.rule: Among beta=5, n=7 successful gamma-overestimates with a successful beta=2 partner, choose gamma error closest to the median of all successful beta=5 gamma-overestimates; ties by sample ID.
selection.scope: Demonstrates a rightward likelihood peak and parameter transmission, not the direction of all MLE estimates.

original_estimator: Frozen five-start joint Nelder-Mead, reject beta<1 after the search; unchanged.
ordinate: profile_log_likelihood minus profile_log_likelihood at true gamma=500
original_return_markers: Full likelihood evaluated at the original three-parameter tuple, not its conditional replacement.

figure_contract.criterion: beta=2/5 columns, n=7/15/30 rows, 50 profiles per cell
figure_contract.transfer: Same paired sample, rows likelihood, conditional beta, conditional eta
figure_contract.axes: Linear, fixed gamma limits/ticks, identical y scales for the same quantity within each figure
